caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular object with chamfered corners, resembling a decorative tray or mold, situated centrally against a plain light background. The tray has a raised border with oval-shaped indents evenly spaced along the inner edge. The interior section of the tray contains a relief or embossed design featuring a cluster of round grapes attached to a stem, alongside a large leaf positioned towards the left. The main colors used are shades of brown and tan, with additional suggested colors such as purple, yellow, green, and blue in the grape cluster and surrounding area, creating a slight iridescent effect. The rendering is detailed and shaded to indicate depth and contours, with the tray viewed from above so that its entire surface and decorations are visible. In the lower right corner of the image, there is an inscription of a name in small, neat letters.
title: Crockery Mold "Rockingham"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
